title: Integral exceptional constructibility on a finite chart cover
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite intermediate extension E of Q_ell in its algebraic closure, and a field k of positive prime characteristic different from ell. Let f:X to Y be a separated finite-type k-morphism between separated finite-type k-schemes. Fix any boundary compactification c, its integral compact-support preservation proof h on Loc(Dbc), any right adjoint G of that restricted compact-support functor, and its adjunction. For K in Loc(Dbc(Y,O_E)) whose underlying object belongs to Dbc(Y,O_E), there is a natural number n and opens U_a of X indexed by Fin n covering X, such that every derived restriction of the underlying object G K to U_a belongs to Dbc(U_a,O_E). This asserts local constructibility only; no global membership or restricted adjunction is assumed.

proof.text: Use only the coefficient-independent geometric cover clause of restrictionLocal, specialized to the rational field E and its existing Brown adjunction. It provides finite affine source opens mapping to affine target opens and closed embeddings i into relative affine spaces, with i p v = u f. No rational preservation or factorization clause is applied to integral coefficients.

For integral O_E, integralLocalizingCompactSupport gives maps_localizing, localizing_pull, constructible_pull and composition isomorphisms. Restrict the actual ambient open adjunction to the full localizing subcategories using fullyFaithful inclusions and identity component comparisons; mateOpenTrivialLowerShriek identifies its left functor with the compactification image for (u,id). Thus the right functor is actual derived open pullback.

Eliminate compactification_over_base directly inside this proposition proof to obtain boundary compactifications of i, p and ip. No definition chooses arbitrary data from its nonempty conclusion; only the existential witnesses needed for this proposition are used. Take the integral Brown adjunctions for i and p. Lift the integral compact-support composition isomorphisms through the full inclusions. The equality i p v = u f lets the two composites have the identical compactification image as left adjoint. Compose the adjunctions and apply Adjunction.rightAdjointUniq, obtaining a natural isomorphism G followed by u-pullback to v-pullback followed by Gp and Gi.

constructible_pull preserves the input under v. integralRestrictionLine gives the affine-space Brown comparison and constructibility of its explicit twist-shift candidate; transporting along the comparison gives constructibility after Gp. integralRestrictionClosed compares Gi with derived sections with support and proves constructibility of that functor. Transport these conclusions through the right-adjoint comparison. Isomorphism invariance is proved directly from boundedness and the finite constant local model witnesses.

The standing schemes are Noetherian, so the chart opens and every chart map are quasi-compact and stay separated of finite type over k. Replace each affine open immersion u by its open image O and the canonical isoOpensRange isomorphism. Apply integral constructible_pull along its inverse, then leftDerivedUpperStarComp and the equality e.inv u = O.ι to obtain the asserted ordinary-open restriction. The original joint surjectivity proves iSup O = top, including empty families.

    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f]
    (c : Compactification.BoundaryCompactification f)
    (h : ∀ K, localizing (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) X K →
      localizing (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) Y
        ((image (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) c.obj.obj).obj K))
    (G : (localizing (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) Y).FullSubcategory ⥤
      (localizing (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) X).FullSubcategory)
    (adj : lowerShriek (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) c.obj.obj h ⊣ G)
    (K : (localizing (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) Y).FullSubcategory)
    (hK : generators (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) Y K.obj) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → X.Opens), iSup U = ⊤ ∧
      ∀ a : Fin n, generators (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) (U a).toScheme
